# Terror Wave randomizer engine

This project embeds the unmodified Windows executable for **Lufia II Terror Wave Randomizer 3.16** by Abyssonym.

- Upstream project: <https://github.com/abyssonym/terrorwave>
- Version source: <https://github.com/abyssonym/terrorwave/tree/V3.16>
- Embedded executable SHA-256: `769b041d1fad796ba36c839fe9bc32a43a4b4df7fe22dbc5ac91a7a1dd90d3e6`

The supplied upstream snapshot has no top-level license file. Its `randomtools` dependency contains a GPL-3.0 license. Confirm redistribution terms with the upstream author before publishing a bundled binary. The engine is kept as a separate executable and invoked as a child process by this GUI.
